text:
Alice: Quick sync — we need to lock the Launchpad observability launch scope by EOD. Customers pushed for cost heatmaps + trace hook SDK. What can we realistically deliver in beta?
Marco: From ops perspective minimal must-haves: dashboard templates (latency / cost / error), a trace hook that tags requests with a redacted tenant_id and route, and a manual sampling kill-switch.
Priya: Dev note: high-cardinality tags (tenant_id) will explode storage if we don't sample. Recommend rolling sampler + cardinality limiter. Example config we can prototype:
```
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.01   # 1%
  per_tenant_overrides: {}
cardinality_limit: 30
```
Jordan: On the metrics side I can emit `tokens_by_route` counters with labels (route, model_variant). For cost heatmaps we need mapping from route -> feature (app-side tag).
Sam: Customers are explicit: they want "cost per feature" not just route. That requires a mapping layer or app-provided feature tag. Pilot customers can add that tag if we provide the SDK doc.
Alice: Proposed acceptance criteria for beta: 1) Dashboard templates for latency / cost / error (configurable), 2) Trace hook SDK + quickstart docs (redacted tenant_id), 3) Per-route token metrics emitted and ingested into telemetry pipeline, 4) Canary with 2 pilot customers running for 2 weeks, 5) Sampling/regression tests to ensure no explosion in cardinality.
Marco: Ops asks: include fallback sampling policy (auto-throttle if memory > 70%), alerting on trace ingestion lag, and a kill-switch endpoint `/__obs/sampling/override`.
Priya: We'll add a debug endpoint and env var override. Also recommend default redaction + pseudonymization lib. Security signoff required.
Jordan: Rollout plan suggestion: week 0 internal alpha, week 1 pilot A, week 2 pilot B, measure token delta, dashboard load time < 30s, no more than 0.1% increase in token billing anomalies.
Sam: Pilot candidates: ACMEHealth (HIPAA-ish) and DocuCraft (SaaS). ACME wants heatmap by "feature" and spike alerts for error rate > 2x baseline.
Alice: Tradeoff call: prioritize heatmap + alerts over full trace templating. If we need to cut scope, drop trace templating options (advanced views) in favor of stable metrics and heatmap.
Priya: Rough ETA: dashboards 5d, trace SDK 6d, sampling infra 3d, metrics pipeline + ingestion 4d. Parallelism reduces wall time to ~3 sprints if we sequence carefully.
Marco: Ops constraint: canary must include a step to verify cardinality < 50M spans/day, otherwise rollback. Also prefer redaction by default for tenant_id.
Security: Redaction + pseudonymization by default is acceptable. We'll provide a small lib for deterministic hashing and guidance for K-anonymity.
Alice: Decision checkpoint for EOD: ship beta with redacted tenant_id, heatmap + alerts, trace hook alpha (no high-card tags), pilot invites sent. Owners?
Priya: I will own dev + SDK deliverables.
Jordan: I'll own metrics schema + pipeline proof-of-concept.
Marco: I'll own canary ops and runbook.
Sam: I'll coordinate pilots and customer comms.
Alice: Action items — Priya: PR for SDK spec by Tue COB; Jordan: metric schema + ingestion demo by Wed; Marco: canary runbook draft by Thu; Sam: pilot NDAs + onboarding checklist by Thu.
Sam: On it. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary cluster create at 2024-12-02T14:00Z
Alice: Great. Dropping follow-ups into #obs-roadmap, will sync tomorrow 10am PT. End of thread.
